tmp:3543: ketanei amanah — 'those of little faith': the spiritual state/category of people deficient in emunah, whose weak faith necessitates fasting and harsh devotions
tmp:3544: ketzar ruach — 'shortness of spirit/breath': the state of impatience and constricted spirit (cf. Exodus 6:9) stemming from little faith, opposite of patient, expansive breath of emunah
tmp:3545: "af ein yesh ruach bahem" — verse fragment (Habakkuk 2:19/Jeremiah 10:14, of idols) 'there is no breath/spirit in them,' cited as prooftext for absence of ruach/spirit linked to faithlessness
tmp:3546: kavvanat Elul — the Arizal's kabbalistic meditative intentions for the month of Elul, keyed to 'He who makes a path in the sea' (Isaiah 43:16), functioning as tikkun for the blemished covenant
tmp:3547: finding one's zivug (destined marriage partner) such that she is not 'against him' (a menagedet, opponent) but rather in accord with his will — the restored-match state achieved via tikkun ha-brit
tmp:3548: the Elul kavvanot as the specific tikkun (rectification) for pegam ha-brit — the secret Avraham transmitted to Eliezer when sending him to find Yitzchak's match
tmp:3549: the reversal whereby desire toward him is re-created in her — the restored ratzon of the destined bride toward her partner effected by tikkun ha-brit/Elul kavvanot
tmp:3550: the remedial action of coming to the bar-da'at (the man of Da'at, the tzaddik) to hear Torah directly from his mouth — the means of finding one's shidduch
tmp:3551: the resulting capacity to find one's shidduch (marriage match) — outcome of hearing Torah from the bar-da'at, since Da'at mediates the two opposites of every match
tmp:3553: Sha'ar ha-Charsit — the 'Pottery/Potsherd Gate' (Jeremiah 19:2, gate facing Gei Ben-Hinnom), place-name invoked in the symbolism of breaking a clay vessel at an engagement
tmp:3554: Gei Ben-Hinnom — the Valley of Hinnom outside Jerusalem, the toponym underlying 'Gehinnom' (purgatory), linked to the bad-wife teaching of Eruvin 41b and the broken clay vessel
tmp:3556: hitkashrut — the act of truly binding/attaching oneself to true tzaddikim, which yields complete teshuvah, atonement, sweetening of judgments, and the unification of the Holy One and His Shekhinah
tmp:3557: mi'ut ha-levanah — the kabbalistic 'diminishment of the moon': Malkhut/Lower Wisdom shrunken when worldly wisdoms separate from Torah, synonymous with the exile of the Shekhinah
tmp:3558: the totality of the holy Torah identified as Chokhmah Ila'ah (Upper Wisdom) — Torah as the supernal wisdom from which all lower worldly wisdoms derive
tmp:3560: the filling of the moon's blemish (pegimat ha-levanah) — restoration of diminished Malkhut/Lower Wisdom, read from Targum on 'the wisdom of Shlomo increased' (I Kings 5)
tmp:3561: the sweetening/nullification of all judgments (dinim) and atonement of all sins — the effect when the two 'kings'/wisdoms unite and the moon's blemish is filled (Zohar Vayigash)
tmp:3562: the tzaddik's act of clothing (halbashah) the light of Torah in mundane stories/conversation — garbing Upper Wisdom in narrative so lower minds can receive it
tmp:3563: the tzaddik's function of binding Chokhmah Tata'ah (Lower Wisdom/Malkhut) with Chokhmah Ila'ah (Upper Wisdom) — the coupling that unites the two worlds
tmp:3565: halbashah — 'enclothement': the kabbalistic mechanism of garbing a higher light (Torah/Upper Wisdom) within lower garments (stories, worldly speech)
tmp:3566: 'et' (אֵת) — the accusative particle in 'Vayedaber Elokim et,' read as a symbol of Chokhmah Ila'ah (Upper Wisdom), as in 'et hashamayim'
tmp:3567: 'Vayedaber' ('And He spoke,' Exodus 20:1) — the word read as a term of zivug (coupling/connection), per 'they saw her medaberet' (Ketubot 13a)
tmp:3569: the paired kabbalistic terms Chokhmah Ila'ah and Chokhmah Tata'ah — Upper Wisdom (Torah/supernal world) and Lower Wisdom (Malkhut/worldly wisdoms), the two worlds whose union the tzaddik effects
tmp:3572: the student learning from the master — the rav–talmid relation as the model for how Chokhmah Tata'ah suckles and receives from Chokhmah Ila'ah
tmp:3575: the Ten Kinds of Melody (asarah minei neginah — Berakhah, Ashrei, Maskil, etc.) with which the Book of Psalms was composed, the power basis of the Tikkun HaKlali
tmp:3576: tikkun le-mikreh lailah — the rectification for a nocturnal seminal emission: reciting the ten psalms (Tikkun HaKlali) corresponding to the ten kinds of melody
tmp:3578: mocho ve-da'ato — the tzaddik's brain/mind and consciousness, one of the 'heads' (rosh) that gather on Rosh Hashanah when one is with the tzaddik
tmp:3579: go'el — 'redeemer': the kinsman-redeemer role (Boaz with Ruth), keyed to the secret of joining ge'ulah (redemption blessing) to tefillah (prayer)
tmp:3580: the practice of innovating a novel Torah insight (chiddush) in the Rebbe's teachings — the act Rabbi Nachman urged his followers to attempt when studying his Torah
tmp:3581: a great tikkun for hirhurim — the rectification of illicit/stray thoughts effected by innovating chiddushim in Torah
